svg.title: Two cross-sections of the upper films, one above the other, cut off at the bottom. Before the step a thick pale oxide buries a metal line and a wider metal shape carrying a raised thin plate, its top higher over the metal than over the gap. After it the oxide is polished flat, leaving a layer of it over the metal, thinner over the plate.

svg.text: The oxide is polished flat, leaving a controlled
thickness over the metal and the capacitor plates.
The lower part of the slice is not drawn.
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
